meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why did Owen find out from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing those times down. Kids draft in other places and paste it in. Procedure 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody did.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Let me see the scene. A student misquoting a line from memory is not a crime. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Okay. Thursday at 8:15, in your room, with the vice-principal and no one else. I'll agree to it to put this behind him, and I want it in an email tonight: the new mark replaces the zero, it's entered before December 1, and nothing goes in his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in the meeting that Owen will do a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room with the vice-principal, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing goes in his record. I still require written confirmation that the new mark replaces the zero, that it is entered before December 1, and that nothing is placed in his record. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal; she still wants written confirmation tonight that the new mark replaces the zero, is entered before December 1, and leaves nothing on his record, which is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her in one sentence, then gave her dated evidence she could check herself, the line that is not in the play, so she had nothing to push against.
What cost ground: Nothing; you never leaned on the detector score, never accused Owen, and never offered a deal before showing evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history with the 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58 times came very close to that night, which is why she went short and straight to procedure, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided on the zero, you never answered, so say plainly who decided and on what basis before you move to your evidence.
